import novamind_api as nm

# Tier cost per unit/day
TIER_COST = {1: 0.0003, 2: 0.002, 3: 0.006, 4: 0.012, 5: 0.012}
PLAN_TIER = {'A': 1, 'B': 3, 'C': 4}

print("=== USAGE & COMPUTE BY PLAN (last 7 days) ===")
q = nm.query("""
SELECT s.plan as plan, COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id) as n_users,
       SUM(du.usage_units) as total_usage
FROM daily_usage du
JOIN subscriptions s ON du.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
WHERE du.day > 189
GROUP BY s.plan
""")
total_now=0; total_t2_B=0
for r in q['rows']:
    plan=r['plan']; usage=r['total_usage'] or 0; tier=PLAN_TIER.get(plan,3)
    cost=usage*TIER_COST[tier]
    total_now+=cost
    print(f"  Plan {plan} (tier{tier}): users={r['n_users']} usage={usage:,.0f} compute_7d=${cost:,.0f}")
    if plan=='B':
        costB_t2 = usage*TIER_COST[2]
        print(f"      --> Plan B at TIER 2: ${costB_t2:,.0f}  (SAVINGS ${cost-costB_t2:,.0f}/wk)")
print(f"  TOTAL compute (calc): ${total_now:,.0f}")

print("\n=== DURABLE BASE AT RISK (subs >35 days old = past 2nd bill) ===")
day = nm.vars.current_day
q2 = nm.query(f"""
SELECT s.plan as plan, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(s.effective_price) as avgp, SUM(s.effective_price) as sump
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S2' AND s.start_day <= {day-35}
GROUP BY s.plan
""")
durable_rev_mo=0
for r in q2['rows']:
    print(f"  S2-{r['plan']} durables(>35d): n={r['n']} avgprice=${r['avgp']:.0f} monthly_rev=${r['sump']:,.0f}")
    durable_rev_mo += r['sump'] or 0
print(f"  TOTAL durable monthly recurring: ${durable_rev_mo:,.0f} (=${durable_rev_mo/30*7:,.0f}/wk)")

print("\n=== FRESH (washers, <35d, will mostly churn) ===")
q3 = nm.query(f"""
SELECT s.plan as plan, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(s.effective_price) as avgp
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S2' AND s.start_day > {day-35}
GROUP BY s.plan
""")
for r in q3['rows']:
    print(f"  S2-{r['plan']} fresh(<35d): n={r['n']} avgprice=${r['avgp']:.0f}")
